description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Returned Pastcaller
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Returned Pastcaller
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
